column1: # The holds of the pointer lint (//:pointer_lint, tools/build/lint/defs.bzl,
# pointer_lint; the rules: docs/design/mojo_safety_and_idioms.md): the sites that
# were in the tree when the lint landed. One row per rule and file, tab-separated:
# <rule> <file> <count> <reason>. The file must hold exactly <count> sites of the
# rule: one more is a new site, which fails the build naming it; one fewer fails
# too, asking for the count to be lowered or the row deleted. So this file only
# shrinks. Fix a site, then lower its row.
